key_provisions_or_claims: Supports EP call for a dedicated EU proposal on algorithmic management at work after assessing existing law.
Calls for extending Platform Work Directive algorithmic management principles to all workers.
Requires algorithmic impact assessments with workers' representatives before AM deployment.
Insists on human-in-control, right to human review, and limits on intrusive monitoring such as emotional data.
Urges AI Office cooperation with social partners; psychosocial risks to be covered by OSH risk assessment.
annotation.summary_en: EESC exploratory opinion requested by the Cypriot Presidency on using AI and algorithmic management to improve job quality. It backs a dedicated EU proposal on algorithmic management, full enforcement of the GDPR and AI Act, workers' involvement, transparency, human-in-control, OSH coverage of psychosocial risks, and a stronger role for social dialogue.
annotation.title_clean: Enhancing quality in employment and working conditions by introducing and promoting related tools (including AI) and strengthening social dialogue and collective bargaining
